data.summary:
**When:** [Your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), as one of your **GENESTEALER CULTS** units **declares a charge** while it is up to 12" from a **TYRANIDS** unit of yours that is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit.

**Target:** That **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit.

**Effect:** The unit gets +1 to its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step). You can also use this Stratagem's second part: if you do, the unit can re-roll its Charge rolls, and its [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) must end in Engagement Range of an enemy unit that is in Engagement Range of that **TYRANIDS** unit.

window: friendly GENESTEALER CULTS declares a charge

optionalReroll.chargeMoveMustEnd: engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that same friendly TYRANIDS unit
